{{Quote|The hearts of the Myneyrshi people overflow with gratitude, Jedi Skywalker. Our debt to you is great|translated=1|Roax|<ref name="Legacy 43" />}}
'''Roax''' was the leader of the [[Myneyrsh]] tribe living on [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]] following its devastation by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|We demand rite of punishment! Give her to us, Jedi&mdash;Or die with her!|translated=1|Roax to Kol Skywalker|<ref name="Legacy 43" />}}
As the leader of the [[Myneyrsh]] tribe living on [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]], Roax welcomed the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kol Skywalker]] for his efforts to restore the planet made barely inhabitable by the [[Yuuzhan Vong War|war]] as the part of the [[Ossus Project]]. However, the Project was sabotaged by the [[One Sith]] and Wayland's inhabitants began to turn into the [[vongspawn]], including Roax.<ref name="Legacy 43" />

Afterwards, Roax [[Skirmish on Wayland (126 ABY)|confronted]] Skywalker and demanded he hand over [[Nei Rin]], the Project's [[Master Shaper]], for punishment as the Myneyrsh held her responsible for the event. However, Skywalker refused, and pushed Roax and the other Myneyrshi off his ship's landing platform as it left the planet, swearing to return and undo what had been done.<ref name="Legacy 43" />

Many years later, when Kol's son [[Cade Skywalker|Cade]] returned to the planet, Cade and his party were attacked by several Vongformed Myneyrshi. He informed his crew not to kill them, believing that one might be Roax, much to the dismay of crew member [[Jariah Syn]]. Shortly afterwards, and Skywalker and Syn were knocked unconscious while [[Deliah Blue]] was taken captive.<ref name="Legacy 44">[[Legacy (2006) 44|''Legacy'' (2006) 44]]</ref>
